name: A/D Foresight Nix
desc:
At start of turn, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to unit for 1 turn.

If a Rally or movement Assist skill is used by unit or targets unit, grants【Null Foresight Snare】 to allies within 3 spaces of both unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally (including unit and that ally) after movement for 1 turn.

If unit initiates combat or is within 3 spaces of an ally, grants bonus to unit's Atk/Def = number of Bonus effects active on foe + 10 (max 14; excluding stat bonuses), unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), reduces damage from foe's first attack by X ("first attack" normally means only the first strike; for effects that grant "unit attacks twice," it means the first and second strikes; if Foresight Snare is active on foe, X = 15; otherwise, X = 7), and reduces the percentage of foe's non-Special "reduce damage by X%" skills by 50% during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

【Null Foresight Snare】
Neutralizes effects of foe's【Foresight Snare】.

【Foresight Snare】
If foe initiates combat and there were no combat instances on the current turn yet (player phase and enemy phase are counted separately), triggers the following effects:
- Cancels foe's attack, completing their action.
- Inflicts Isolation and status preventing counterattacks on foe through foe's next action.
- Cancels Foresight Snare granted to your army.

(These effects trigger after Aether Raids traps but before Savior; does not trigger in Pawns of Loki).

Unit cannot be protected by Savior through their next action.
